name: Candle of Invocation

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Light the candle
powers.text: While it burns (up to 4 hours in all), you and your allies within 30 ft have Advantage on attack rolls, saves and checks, and a Cleric or Druid within 30 ft can cast level 1 spells without slots.

powers.name: Gate
powers.text: Use up the candle to cast Gate.

summary: Lit, it gives you and your allies within 30 ft Advantage on attacks, saves and checks; or it opens a Gate.
text: This slender taper is dedicated to a deity and shares that deity's alignment. The candle's magic is activated when the candle is lit, which requires a Magic action. After burning for 4 hours, the candle is destroyed. You can snuff it out early for use at a later time. Deduct the time it burned in increments of 1 minute from the candle's total burn time. While lit, the candle sheds Dim Light in a 30-foot radius. Any creature within that light whose alignment matches that of the candle makes attack rolls, saving throws and ability checks with Advantage. In addition, a Cleric or Druid in the light whose alignment matches the candle's can cast level 1 spells they have prepared without expending spell slots, though the spell's effect is as if cast with a level 1 slot. Alternatively, when you light the candle for the first time, you can cast Gate with it. Doing so destroys the candle. (The game doesn't track alignment: the candle's blessing falls on the party.)
